source.author: ov
source.text: Dixerat: induitur velamina mille colorum Iris, et arcuato caelum curvamine signans tecta petit iussi sub nube latentia regis.
source.text_original: Dixerat: induitur velamina mille colorum / Iris, et arcuato caelum curvamine signans / tecta petit iussi sub nube latentia regis.
source.text_english: She had spoken: Iris clothes herself in garments of a thousand colors, and, marking the sky with her arched curve, seeks the roof hidden beneath a cloud of the king’s command.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: qua iussos sed tandem quaerere Colchos arte queat?
reuse.text_original: qua iussos sed tandem quaerere Colchos / arte queat?
reuse.text_english: By what means could he at last seek out the Colchians, since he was ordered?
